desc.en: The Algiers Metro is a rapid transit system that serves Algiers, the capital of Algeria. Opened in 2011, it was the second metro system to open in Africa, after the Cairo Metro. The system currently serves 19 stations over a total route length of approximately 18.5 kilometres (11.5 mi), connecting areas such as the historic Casbah of Algiers to neighbouring communities. As of 2026, future extension projects to Line 1 are underway to provide service to Houari Boumediene International Airport, Dar El Beïda Bab El Oued and other areas around the capital.
